The [[Iron Forgeman]] is a huge cyclopian mechanical golem [[construct]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]] made by the [[Stone Summit]] to eventually replace their [[Dredge Slave]]s. It is also intended to be used as a weapon against the [[Deldrimor]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]]. It is powered by three bound [[Flame Djinn]], and is controlled by three [[Rage Binder]]s.

==Walkthrough==
{{see|The Forge Heart#Walkthrough}}
The Iron Forgeman is not a [[target]]able [[creature]], and is not fought directly. Instead, it is destroyed by killing the Rage Binders and releasing the Flame Djinn. The Rage Binders resurrect and must all be dead at the same time to unleash the Djinn.

== Quests ==
'''Quests involved in:'''
* [[The Forge Heart]]
* [[The Iron Forgeman (Zaishen quest)]]

== Skills ==
* {{monster skill icon|Sorrow's Fist}}
* {{monster skill icon|Sorrow's Flame}}

== Notes ==
* While in the area of the Iron Forgeman, two huge forge mechanics will attack the party from the ceiling:
** A metal ball will strike with [[Sorrow's Fist]].
** Molten metal will be poured on the party, causing [[Sorrow's Flame]].
* Being hit by the Iron Forgeman's Sorrow's Flame will hatch the [[Black Moa Chick]] from a completed [[Incubator Kit]].
* Although the Iron Forgeman is not a targetable [[NPC]], destroying it is the objective of the [[Zaishen Bounty]] quest [[The Iron Forgeman (Zaishen quest)|The Iron Forgeman]].

== Trivia ==
* On the second level of [[Oola's Lab]], there are several scaled down replicas of the Iron Forgeman in various states of assembly.
